topic: Index funds vs whole life insurance (Theo vs Selma)

scenes.narration: Whole life can cost four hundred thousand over a lifetime. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar holding a clipboard with two charts, one labeled INDEX FUND and one labeled WHOLE LIFE, comic burst banner reads FOUR HUNDRED THOUSAND DIFFERENCE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Theo and Selma each can save five hundred dollars per month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man theo and woman selma each holding identical envelopes stamped FIVE HUNDRED A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both meet with financial product salespeople offering different paths.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, theo with a glossy whole life brochure, selma with a simple index fund printout, two salespeople in different offices, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Theo signs up for a five hundred dollar whole life policy.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, theo at a kitchen table signing a glossy WHOLE LIFE POLICY contract, an agent smiling beside him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The polished agent calls it a guaranteed safe investment for life.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a slick agent in a suit pointing at a poster reading GUARANTEED SAFE FOR LIFE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Selma buys a thirty dollar term life policy and stops there.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, selma at a kitchen table holding a small term life paper stamped THIRTY A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She invests the remaining four hundred seventy in a low cost index fund.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, selma tapping AUTO INVEST FOUR SEVENTY on a brokerage app, a low cost fund chart on the screen, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: After thirty years Theo paid in one hundred eighty thousand dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, older man theo holding a thick stack of premium statements stamped ONE EIGHTY PAID IN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His cash value is only seventy thousand dollars total.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked older theo at a kitchen table holding a policy statement reading CASH VALUE SEVENTY THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Selma's index fund is now worth six hundred ten thousand dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, older woman selma smiling at a brokerage app reading SIX HUNDRED TEN THOUSAND in big green numbers, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same monthly cost, same life coverage, vastly different result.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side theo with a thin policy, right side selma with a tall index fund chart, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Buy term and invest the rest. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar holding a clipboard labeled BUY TERM INVEST THE REST, comic burst banner reads SEE YOU NEXT VISIT, kids comic book illustration
